---
title: Glossary
sidebar_position: 2
---

| Term | Meaning in this documentation |
| --- | --- |
| TARA | Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment. |
| Project | The intended unit for organising and sharing an assessment; the exact data model is still being defined. |
| RBAC | Role-based access control; the project roles and permissions still need to be specified. |
| LLM | Large language model; an optional form of assistance being considered for the prototype. |
| Prototype | An application under development whose current capabilities must be checked against its release notes. |

Normative definitions will be added or refined after review of the relevant
standard. This glossary is not a replacement for that source.
